text.formatted: While you wear these light shoes, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. However, the slippers don't allow you to move this way on a slippery surface, such as one covered by ice or oil.

gaps.name: Climbing on vertical surfaces or ceilings with free hands, except on slippery surfaces, is not represented by the climbing-speed grant.
